pr.title: Harden Azure Functions VS Code launch lifecycle
pr.author: ellahathaway

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Dashboard / Dashboard (ubuntu-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: Failure is a single test assertion failure in Aspire.Dashboard.Tests unrelated to the PR's changes, which only touched extension/ (VS Code extension) files. The test failure is a race-condition-style duplicate event assertion, not a build or PR-code-caused failure.

failed_tests.name: Aspire.Dashboard.Tests.Model.DashboardClientTests.SubscribeResources_ReplicaStartedAtChanged_EmitsParentChange
failed_tests.error:
Assert.Single() Failure: The collection contained 2 matching items
Expected:      (predicate expression)
Collection:    [ResourceViewModelChange { ChangeType = Upsert, Resource = Aspire.Dashboard.Model.ResourceViewModel }, ResourceViewModelChange { ChangeType = Upsert, Resource = Aspire.Dashboard.Model.ResourceViewModel }, ResourceViewModelChange { ChangeType = Upsert, Resource = Aspire.Dashboard.Model.ResourceViewModel }, ResourceViewModelChange { ChangeType = Upsert, Resource = Aspire.Dashboard.Model.ResourceViewModel }]

failed_tests.reason: The test asserts exactly one matching change event, but two matching upsert events were emitted (indices 0 and 3), indicating a timing/ordering race in the resource change subscription stream rather than an assertion tied to any PR-modified code. PR #19205 only modifies files under extension/ (VS Code extension), not Aspire.Dashboard or its tests.
